tasks.short: Propose biofuels products from research findings

steps.what: Open findings from applied biomass research
Draft a proposal that cites the stored findings

loop.purpose: Draft proposal text that cites only stored research findings.
loop.input: The project id and the stored result ids.
loop.output: A draft that cites those ids, or a stop.
loop.check: Every cited id equals a stored result.
loop.stop: Stop when a cited id is missing.
loop.why_not_simpler: A proposal that adds a product or a technology with no finding cannot be sent.

steps.what: Propose products, processes, technologies, or applications
Send the biofuels proposal the manager signed

tasks.design: Findings from applied biofuels or biomass projects are opened from {DOCS}. A draft cites only those findings. The manager proposes the product, process, technology, or application and signs before it is sent. A finding that is not stored is not cited.
tasks.previous_blocker: The proposal was rewritten from project notes, and a result was easy to overstate.
tasks.enabler_now: Findings are stored by id, so a draft either cites them or stops.
tasks.still_hard: What to propose, beyond the findings, stays with the manager.

ambition.what: A project with stored findings gets a draft the day the finding is filed, and the manager still proposes.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the finding beside the sentence.

evidence.claim: A proposal cites stored findings, and the manager signs what is sent. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a new product or process is being proposed and ends when the manager has signed the proposal.
A finding has project id, finding id, and text, written by the manager from the research. A sentence with no finding id is dropped.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether senior management wants a claim the findings do not support.
research_questions: Which drafts stopped because a finding id was missing?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: proposal the manager signed from those findings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts proposals whose findings are already stored. A new claim is written by the manager, and the signature stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the pretreatment technology for the biomass

tasks.enabler_now: The named technology is on the experiment, so the bench starts from it.
tasks.still_hard: Running the pretreatment, and reading what happened, stay with the manager.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees which technology is to be tested before the run.

assumptions: The work starts when a pretreatment experiment is planned and ends when the manager has conducted it or noted what was not tested.
The experiment has biomass id and technology id, written by the manager. A result is written by the manager after the run.

unknowns: Whether the named technology can be run on this biomass in this lab.

tasks.short: Prepare biofuels research reports for senior management

steps.what: Open stored biofuels research and development results
Draft the report from the stored results

loop.purpose: Prepare report sentences that cite only stored research results.
loop.input: The project id and the stored result ids.
loop.output: A draft that cites those ids, or a stop.
loop.check: Every cited id equals a stored result.
loop.stop: Stop when a cited id is missing.
loop.why_not_simpler: A report that invents a result cannot go to senior management.

steps.what: Prepare the report for technical professionals
Send the report to senior management

tasks.design: Stored research and development results are opened from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The report is drafted only from those results. The manager prepares it for technical professionals and senior management, and it is sent only after that preparation. A missing result stops the sentence.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report was rebuilt from bench books the week management asked.
tasks.enabler_now: Results are stored by id, so the draft cites them instead of retyping them.
tasks.still_hard: What the result means, and whether it is ready for management, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager prepares the report before it is sent.

ambition.what: A project with stored results gets a draft the day they are filed, and the manager still prepares the report.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees each result beside the sentence.

evidence.claim: A research report cites stored results, and the manager prepares it before it is sent. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a research report is due and ends when the manager has prepared it.
A result has project id, result id, and value, entered from the bench. A sentence with no result id is dropped.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether management wants commentary the results do not support.
research_questions: Which sentences stopped because a result was missing?

tasks.short: Develop lab scale models of industrial processes

steps.what: Open the industrial scale process description
Develop lab scale models of the fermentation
Note industrial processes the model did not hold

tasks.design: The industrial process description, including fermentation where that is the process, is opened from {DOCS}. The manager develops the lab scale model. Processes the model did not hold stay noted. The description is not itself a model.
tasks.previous_blocker: The industrial description and the lab notes were kept apart, so a difference was found late.
tasks.enabler_now: The description is stored, so the lab model starts from the same process.
tasks.still_hard: Building a model that behaves like the industrial process stays with the manager.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the industrial description before building the lab model.

reach.learn: Which process step the model missed.

evidence.claim: A process description can be opened, and the lab model stays with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an industrial process is to be modelled at lab scale and ends when the manager has developed the model or noted the gap.
The description has process id and steps, written by the manager. The system does not add a step.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Which industrial conditions the lab cannot reproduce.
research_questions: Which process steps the model did not hold?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a description that already exists. Developing the model stays with the manager.
